outcome: The PMO Lead confirms and completes the go-live milestone, and staff correct or withdraw a recorded client reply
acceptance_criteria: On `4411` the replies read shows a "Confirm and complete milestone" form with a required name field, an evidence list of `8101` and `8102` with nothing selected, an optional note and a button that is off until a name and one evidence are chosen — verify: open `/work/4411/go-live`; `frontend/e2e/go-live-completion.spec.ts`.

Sending posts one `POST /work/4411/go-live-milestone` with `action:"confirm_and_complete"`, both revisions from the read, the typed `name`, `acceptance_id:7001`, the chosen `evidence_id`, and `note` only when filled; no `draft_mapping` or `record_completion` call is made — verify: unit test on the body; network panel.
On `4412` the name shows "Go-live", is not editable and is sent unchanged — verify: unit test on the body; e2e.
On `4413` (`can_confirm:false`) and for any fixture with `acceptance_id` null no confirm control is drawn and no reason text is invented — verify: e2e DOM.
On `4414` (empty list) the words "No completion evidence is available yet." show and the button stays off; no evidence id is sent or preselected — verify: e2e; unit test.
A double click on the confirm button sends exactly one POST — verify: unit test with a slow mock counts calls.
On `4415` a 409 shows the changed-record message, re-reads, and a second press sends a body with the new revisions — verify: e2e compares revision values.
On `4419` a 403 shows the API's message and the page stays unchanged after the refetch; a 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once and sends no second POST — verify: unit test counts calls.
On `4416` the page shows "Milestone completed", the milestone name, "Confirmed by the PMO Lead" with the time and note, and no confirm form; the "Milestone" row reads "Recorded" — verify: e2e DOM.
The blank note is omitted and a name over 200 characters or empty is refused before any request — verify: unit test.

On `4417` the current reply row has "Correct" and "Withdraw" controls; the form offers only `changes_requested` and `declined` for a correction, only the read's `channels[]` and only the entry's `roles[]`, and refuses to send without the attestation tick — verify: unit test; network panel.

A correction sends `record_reply` with `receipt_id` and `previous_id` (301) from the `corrections[]` entry, the chosen outcome, `attested:true` and both revisions; a withdrawal sends the same with `outcome:"withdrawn"` and a non-empty `note` — verify: unit tests on both bodies.

On `4418` the withdrawn row has no control and no form offers "withdrawn" for a row that is already withdrawn; on any fixture with `corrections:[]` no correct or withdraw control is drawn — verify: e2e DOM.
A reply with hidden details still shows "Details not available to you", never blank, 0 or "null", and has controls only when `corrections[]` supplies an entry — verify: unit test.

The reply form's `evidence_id` comes only from the source F-114 settles and is never typed or copied from another reply; with no source the form is held with "Add a proof first" and build.md lists it — verify: unit test; build.md.
Both writes disable on a `null` revision and after a 2xx until the refetch; after success the shown history and milestone come from the read — verify: unit test.
Only the routes in the Contract are called by the new files; nothing is sent to the client — verify: grep `liveApi.POST` and `liveApi.GET` in the two new files and `frontend/src/features/go-live`.
A work id not on this line or returning 404 shows exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: e2e (F-114 fixtures).

Against live Django (8030), signed in as the PMO Lead on a go-live item with `can_confirm:true`, the page's milestone block, evidence list and corrections match `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/go-live-replies`; as another user (not the PMO Lead) no confirm control shows — verify: compare the page with the `curl` JSON using the session. Do not complete a real milestone on shared data without the design engineer's say; use a seeded test project.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: the milestone block matches SCR-45-desktop-accepted and -mobile-accepted for the parts kept; hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots against `design/screens.md` SCR-45.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` still passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.
build.md names the board parts hidden and any change to `frontend/mock/go-live.mjs` shape — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: High: confirming the milestone is irreversible in effect (it unlocks hypercare and handover) and uses a PMO Lead authority check on the server; correcting or withdrawing a reply alters recorded acceptance evidence. Surfaces: ui, api, auth (`can_confirm` and role-limited corrections), contract-change (new 1.25.0 fields), product-decision (D-17 answer, acceptance wording). Product acceptance is required because the client-facing outcome flow changes. Sources: backend-answers D-17, F-114 readiness and spec, `contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json` 1.25.0.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
